column_normalization: Analytic radial envelope column at Rin=1/Rout=3000 AU and fixed conical cavity. Discrete numerical columns and total source optical depths are not certified equal.

dust_prescription.draine_long_wavelength_policy: Retain the existing Draine table (ends at 1000 um) and simulator treatment outside it through the 3000-um thermal grid; no new silicate tail or tail-convergence claim.
dust_prescription.laboratory_silicate_density_policy: Retain each supplied material's bulk density; equal dust mass is not equal optical depth
dust_prescription.mass_convention: Total envelope dust mass includes both disjoint species
dust_prescription.silicate: Selected per envelope model; disk always retains Draine silicate/carbon
dust_prescription.silicate_coverage_policy: Exact supplied tables; native simulator extrapolation outside tabulated coverage; no generated optical tails
dust_prescription.size_change_scope: Silicate only; H2O grain sizes stay fixed

preflight: Bounded envelope-only dust initialization on the cluster; production/thermal/broad-coverage wavelengths must pass for every prescription; extra zero-k stress samples remain recorded diagnostics

preflight_revision.change: Remove the erroneous numeric count header from check.lambda: MCFOST lect_lambda reads every numeric line as a wavelength. Retain strict ordered wavelength/shape matching and report actual versus expected dimensions.

previous_revision.change: Require finite valid products at production image wavelengths, ideal/source-rounded temperature centres at custom-table precision, and 100 broad-coverage samples; retain extra zero-k stress failures as recorded diagnostics. Required-wavelength matches take priority.
